motivation: The existing benchmark uses a relatively small frozen utility vector. Its theoretical scope assessment already identifies stronger utility signals and ridge bias as unresolved. Exact moderate-signal population checks show small soft-pooling target shifts, so their effect size must be retained rather than exaggerated.
truth: 3 times the frozen1200-row converged logit vector; an explicit simulation parameter, not human structural truth
matching: shared generated rows, choices, proxies across all methods and prediction cases; no replacement of the moderate-signal results
intervals: diagnostic marginal Wald sandwiches; unadjusted ridge bias; no finite-sample guarantee
retain: all conditions and every status, conditional and issued-and-covers summaries, mean and tail errors
